```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7, dev = "png", dpi = 150)
source(file.path("..", "R", "setup.R"))
source(file.path(.repo_root, "R", "plot_helpers.R"))
```

MERFISH VTA cells, their mapping to scRNA dopaminergic subclusters, and the
A/B/C/D metacluster 3D spatial projections.

```{r load}
bundle  <- readRDS(inputs("merfish_objects"))   # merfish_3d, meta_groups, make_3d_plot, ...
cells   <- data.table::fread(inputs("merfish_cells"))
mapping <- data.table::fread(inputs("merfish_mapping"))
sub_cols <- if (!is.null(bundle$subcluster_cols)) bundle$subcluster_cols else SUBCLUSTER_COLS
meta_groups <- if (!is.null(bundle$meta_groups)) bundle$meta_groups else METACLUSTER_MEMBERS
```

## 3D metacluster projections (interactive)

```{r widgets-3d, results="asis"}
# Regenerate the four A/B/C/D 3D widgets from the bundle's own make_3d_plot().
outd <- file.path(FIGURE_DIR, "04_MERFISH"); dir.create(outd, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
if (is.function(bundle$make_3d_plot) && !is.null(bundle$merfish_3d)) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(plotly); library(htmlwidgets) })
  for (mc in names(meta_groups)) {
    ok <- tryCatch({
      cl <- intersect(meta_groups[[mc]], unique(bundle$merfish_3d$scrna_subcluster))
      w  <- bundle$make_3d_plot(bundle$merfish_3d, cl, paste("Metacluster", mc), 3.5)
      htmlwidgets::saveWidget(w, file.path(outd, sprintf("merfish_3d-metacluster_%s.html", mc)),
                              selfcontained = TRUE)
      TRUE
    }, error = function(e) { message("3D widget ", mc, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); FALSE })
    cat("\n-", mc, if (ok) "— written" else "— FAILED (see log)", "\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("\n_make_3d_plot / merfish_3d not found in the bundle — 3D widgets skipped._\n")
}
```

## Spatial slices (2D)

```{r slices-metacluster, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
cells$metacluster <- factor(cells$metacluster, levels = c("A","B","C","D"))
gg <- ggplot(subset(cells, !is.na(metacluster)), aes(x, y, colour = metacluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = METACLUSTER_COLS, na.value = "grey85", name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~ brain_section_label) + coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "MERFISH VTA cells by metacluster") + theme_submission()
print(gg); save_fig(gg, "04_MERFISH", "slices_metacluster", width = 12, height = 8)
```

```{r slices-subcluster, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
gg <- ggplot(cells, aes(x, y, colour = factor(scrna_subcluster))) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sub_cols, na.value = "grey85", name = "subcluster") +
  facet_wrap(~ brain_section_label) + coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "MERFISH VTA cells by scRNA subcluster") + theme_submission() +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2)))
print(gg); save_fig(gg, "04_MERFISH", "slices_subcluster", width = 12, height = 8)
```

## scRNA ↔ MERFISH mapping

```{r mapping, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
# The exported mapping is one best-match row per MERFISH cluster (the full NxM
# correlation matrix is not exported). Show the best-match correlation per
# MERFISH cluster, coloured by assigned metacluster, and how many MERFISH
# clusters map to each scRNA subcluster.
mapping$metacluster <- factor(mapping$metacluster, levels = c("A","B","C","D"))
gg1 <- ggplot(mapping, aes(reorder(merfish_cluster_id, correlation), correlation,
                           fill = metacluster)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = METACLUSTER_COLS, na.value = "grey85", name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "MERFISH cluster", y = "best-match correlation") + theme_submission() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))
print(gg1); save_fig(gg1, "04_MERFISH", "mapping_best_correlation", width = 8, height = 7)

tab <- mapping %>% dplyr::count(scrna_subcluster_filt, name = "n_merfish_clusters") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_merfish_clusters))
knitr::kable(tab, caption = "MERFISH clusters mapped per scRNA subcluster")
```

## Metacluster membership

```{r membership}
mem <- data.frame(metacluster = names(meta_groups),
                  subclusters = vapply(meta_groups, paste, collapse = ", ", FUN.VALUE = ""))
knitr::kable(mem, row.names = FALSE, caption = "A/B/C/D metacluster membership")
```
